There is no separate task attached to it, so treat the rest of this list as the work and this entry as the receipt. Work the time bands on the roadmap sheet from the quick wins upward and it will be the last thing that pops.

Keep an eye on the timing notes before story points of no return
The platinum pops automatically at 54 of 54

steps: Start a new game
Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end
Trophy pops on mission completion

steps: Follow the main story markers through Chapter 1
Finish the chapter's closing mission
Trophy pops at the chapter break

steps: Continue the main story into Chapter 2
Finish the chapter's closing mission

steps: Continue the main story into Chapter 3
Finish the chapter's closing mission
Trophy pops at the chapter break

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.note: Closes out Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Complete every story mission filed under Chapter 4. Play the chapter's story missions in sequence until the chapter closes and the trophy pops. The description gives no extra conditions, so treat it as a pure story-progress marker.
steps: Continue the main story into Chapter 4
Finish the chapter's closing mission
Trophy pops at the chapter break
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the gold capstone of the campaign, so it only becomes available after the preceding chapters are done. Before starting it, read the timing notes on the few trophies that carry them, because endgame story beats are the classic point of no return.
steps: Finish the story up to the final mission
Read every timing note on this sheet before starting it
Complete the final mission

trophies.note: Story mission: Breakfast Run.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission named Breakfast Run. It arrives as part of the main campaign, so play the story until the mission appears and complete it. The description does not detail the mission's objectives, so follow its in-game prompts as they come.
steps: Progress the story until Breakfast Run appears
Complete the mission
Trophy pops on completion
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.note: Story mission: The Cartel Heist.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a set-piece heist inside the main campaign, so reach it through normal story progress and play it to the end. Stock up on armour and ammo beforehand if the game allows it, since heist missions tend to run long.
steps: Progress the story until The Cartel Heist appears
Prepare armour and ammo if the game offers the chance
Complete the heist mission
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.note: Story mission: Child's Play.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it unlocks through ordinary campaign progress. Play the mission when it surfaces and the trophy pops at its conclusion.
steps: Progress the story until Child's Play appears
Complete the mission
Trophy pops on completion
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.note: Story mission: Headliners.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Reach it by following the main story and complete it when offered. The description names only the mission, so no side conditions are known or expected.
steps: Progress the story until Headliners appears
Complete the mission
Trophy pops on completion
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.note: Story mission set at VCIA, the airport.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around the airport. While the story has you at VCIA, it is also worth attempting the unscheduled departure described under Catch Me If You Can, whose timing note points at this same visit. Complete the mission itself through normal story progress.
steps: Progress the story until VCIA Takedown appears
While at VCIA, attempt the unscheduled departure for Catch Me If You Can
Complete the mission
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.note: Story mission: Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the named set-piece missions in the campaign, reached through story progress. Play it to completion and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Progress the story until Operation Savage Glory appears
Complete the mission
Trophy pops on completion
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.note: The 100% completion stat is the real target.
trophies.guide: Reach a 100 percent completion rating for the game. The description does not enumerate what the percentage is made of, so use the in-game completion stat as the authority and keep clearing story, activities, collectibles and exploration until it reads 100. Most other trophies on this sheet feed into it, which is why the estimate here covers the whole endgame sweep rather than a single task.
steps: Finish the full story
Clear activities, collectibles and exploration categories
Check the in-game completion stat until it reads 100%
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.note: 250 stunts — the longest pure counter on the sheet.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, of whatever kind the game counts as a stunt. This is a volume trophy rather than a skill test, so the efficient route is to fold stunt attempts into ordinary driving instead of farming them in one sitting. The description does not say whether stunt types must be distinct, so repeats should be assumed to count until the in-game counter proves otherwise.
steps: Find a fast car and open road or a ramp
Land stunts whenever you travel, and track the counter here
Reach 250 completed stunts
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.note: Sample every activity type once — a tour of the map.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once; the kit's official summary counts 9 activity types. You only need to sample each one, not master it, so this is a sightseeing lap of Leonida's side content. Work through the activity icons on the map one type at a time and tick them off here as you go.
steps: Open the map and identify each activity type
Play one session of each of the 9 types
Trophy pops when every type has been tried
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.note: Gold medals on all 42 shooting range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them, per the official summary. Learn one range's target pattern at a time and replay it until the gold threshold is routine before moving on. Accuracy challenges usually reward a slower, deliberate pace over spraying, so treat each attempt as practice for the next.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list
Replay each challenge until it scores gold
Gold all 42 challenges
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.note: Win a drone race at all 14 locations.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations, per the official summary. A win is required, not just a finish, so learn each course's line with a practice run before racing it in earnest. Clear locations region by region so travel between race starts stays short.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race start point
Learn the course, then win the race
Repeat at all 14 locations
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.note: 20 race wins, each in a different race.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; the word 'different' is the catch, so replaying one easy race 20 times will not finish this. Keep a tally here of which races you have already won and always pick a fresh one. Start with the shortest races on the map to bank early wins quickly.
steps: Pick a race you have not won yet
Win it and record the win
Repeat until 20 different races are won
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.note: Out-fish Cal in his challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, accept it, and land a better result than he does under whatever scoring the challenge uses. The description does not specify the win condition beyond beating him, so expect a weight or count contest and fish the full timer.
steps: Find Cal and accept the fishing challenge
Fish the full challenge duration
Finish ahead of Cal's score
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.note: Finish one arcade game, start to credits.
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, from start to its end. Any cabinet should do, so pick the shortest or simplest game you can find in an arcade or bar. 'Complete' means finishing it rather than just playing a round, so stay on the machine until the game itself concludes.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet
Start the shortest game on offer
Play it through to completion
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.note: Finish Andy's mission strand.

steps: Meet Andy and accept the first mission
Work through the strand as new missions appear
Complete Andy's final mission
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.note: Finish Kenton's mission strand.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton by playing Kenton's strand from its first job to its last. These contact strands unlock in sequence, so if no new mission appears, progress the story or other strands and check back. The estimate covers the full strand.
steps: Meet Kenton and accept the first mission
Work through the strand as new missions appear
Complete Kenton's final mission
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy by clearing Billy's entire mission strand. Accept Billy's jobs whenever they surface and keep going until the strand's finale unlocks, then finish it. The estimate covers the full strand rather than the last mission alone.
steps: Meet Billy and accept the first mission
Work through the strand as new missions appear
Complete Billy's final mission

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.note: Eight full stranger strands, statewide.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is a short chain for one character, so this trophy is really eight small stories rather than one long one. The named strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone on this sheet are natural candidates to count toward the eight, though the description does not confirm the overlap.
steps: Pick up stranger strands as their markers appear
Finish each strand completely, not just its opener
Complete 8 strands in total

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy by working through Randy's whole strand of jobs. Take the missions in order as they unlock and finish the strand's finale when it appears. The estimate covers the strand end to end.
steps: Meet Randy and accept the first mission
Work through the strand as new missions appear
Complete Randy's final mission
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone by clearing Tyrone's mission strand from first job to last. Strands sometimes pause until you progress elsewhere, so rotate between contacts if Tyrone goes quiet. The estimate covers the full strand.
steps: Meet Tyrone and accept the first mission
Work through the strand as new missions appear
Complete Tyrone's final mission

Chain nearby spots into one route per region and use the counter here to keep count, since the description gives no in-game list to check against.
steps: Find a meditation spot and use the prompt
Route the remaining spots region by region
Meditate at all 18 spots

trophies.note: One unique-animal hunt for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting job and track down the specific animal it names; 'unique' implies a single special target rather than ordinary wildlife. The description does not say where the animal lives, so follow Bret's mission markers and any tracking prompts the hunt gives you.
steps: Accept Bret's hunting job
Track the unique animal using the mission's prompts
Complete the hunt
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.note: Three full card sets — a map-wide collection.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, so this is a long collection sweep rather than a single task; finish one set at a time and use the counter here to track completed sets. The description does not say how many cards make a set, so expect the full sweep to take several sessions and pair it with exploration trophies.
steps: Collect cards whenever you explore a new area
Finish one complete set before chasing the next
Complete 3 sets in total
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.note: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations.

Combine this with the exploration and meditation sweeps so the travel is shared, and keep the tally here because 100 is too many to track from memory.
steps: Learn the WAiNK action when the game introduces it
Use it once in every new location you visit
Reach 100 locations
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.note: 50 challenges — steady background progress.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's short-form tasks, so this builds naturally if you accept them as they appear instead of saving them for the end. The description does not restrict the type, so count every completed challenge here and favour the quick ones when you are choosing.
steps: Accept challenges as they appear on the map
Favour short challenges when several are open
Complete 50 in total
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.note: Shake a 4-star wanted level with your partner present.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. Deliberately build the wanted level up to 4 stars with your partner alongside, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. The escape only counts if the heat fully drops, so stay hidden until the wanted level is gone entirely.
steps: Have your partner with you and raise a 4-star wanted level
Break line of sight with the police
Stay hidden until the wanted level fully clears
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.note: Three shop robberies in one unbroken wanted streak.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level in between. The chain is the hard part: plan a route of three nearby shops, rob the first, and move straight to the next while the heat stays on. If the wanted level drops to zero mid-run, the streak resets and you start again.
steps: Pick three shops close together and bring your partner
Rob the first and keep the wanted level alive
Rob the second and third without the heat dropping
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.note: Discover 100 different vehicles.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery almost certainly means encountering or entering distinct models, so variety matters more than mileage: hop into unfamiliar cars whenever you see one parked or passing. Wealthier districts and the airport usually concentrate rare models, though the description does not name any location, so treat that as a general hunting tip rather than a promise.
steps: Enter every unfamiliar vehicle model you see
Hunt in varied districts to widen the pool
Reach 100 discovered vehicles
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.note: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus activation.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Set the moment up before you trigger it: get at least five enemies in view, ideally grouped, then activate Combat Focus and work through them before it expires. Crowded gang spots or a busy robbery gone loud give you the density you need.
steps: Find a spot with at least five enemies in view
Activate Combat Focus
Take down 5 enemies before it expires
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Timing note: the description fixes this to VCIA, which the story visits for the VCIA Takedown mission. If that story visit is the only time the departure can be staged, leaving the airport normally closes the window — attempt the departure while the story has you there.
trophies.note: An unscheduled departure at the airport — try it during VCIA Takedown.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport — in plain terms, take off or leave in a way the airport did not schedule, most plausibly by taking a plane that is not yours. The natural window is the VCIA Takedown story mission, which puts you on the airfield with aircraft around. If a plane is reachable during that mission, take it and get airborne.
steps: Reach VCIA, ideally during VCIA Takedown
Find an aircraft you can enter
Take off without authorisation
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.note: Something involving a Rhino tank; the wording is a joke.
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke line — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and Rhinos are the series' tanks, so this trophy involves a tank in some way the description does not spell out. Honest position: the exact trigger is not pinned down by the description. The reasonable attempts are to steal or drive a Rhino when one appears at high wanted levels or military locations, and to survive an encounter with one.
steps: Raise the wanted level or find a military spot where Rhinos appear
Enter or drive a Rhino if the chance comes
If it does not pop, survive a Rhino engagement and retry
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.note: One jewelry store robbery, unseen from start to finish.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Detection is the fail state, so plan the quiet version: approach without drawing attention, take what the robbery allows, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt is spent — walk away, let things cool down, and try the same store again later.
steps: Find a jewelry store and watch its routine
Enter quietly and rob it without being spotted
Leave the area still undetected
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.note: Five bank vault robberies, each with a clean escape.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. A vault robbery only counts once you have got away, so plan the exit before you go in: a fast car placed nearby and a route that breaks line of sight quickly. Count each successful vault here; failed escapes do not advance the tally.
steps: Case a bank and stage a getaway vehicle
Rob the vault
Escape the wanted level, then repeat 5 times
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.note: One armored truck robbery with an escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks need force to open — expect to use explosives or sustained fire on the rear doors once you find one on the road. Grab what spills out and lose the wanted level; the trophy needs the escape, not just the robbery.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Force it open and take the money
Escape the wanted level
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.note: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas, per the official summary. This is a map-reveal sweep: travel into every district and region until each one registers as visited. A plane or a long coastal drive covers ground fastest, and the counter here tracks areas as you confirm them, since the description does not promise an in-game checklist.
steps: Open the map and note which regions are unvisited
Travel region by region, including the far corners
Visit all 52 areas
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.note: One illegal operation robbed from each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, per the official summary. The spread matters more than the haul: robbing the same gang twice does not advance this. Learn which operation belongs to which gang as you scout, rob one per gang, and keep the per-gang tally here.
steps: Identify an illegal operation and its owning gang
Rob it and escape
Repeat until all 9 gangs have been hit once
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Timing note: the name points at the beginning of the game and the description fixes the moment to a cocktail on Ocean Beach. If that moment belongs to the opening stretch, it may not be recreatable later — try it the first time you reach Ocean Beach.
trophies.note: A cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — do it early.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar or drinks spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view the description asks for. The description does not name a specific venue, so if the first spot does not trigger it, try another Ocean Beach bar before assuming anything more exotic is required.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach
Find a bar and order a cocktail
Drink it somewhere with a view
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.note: Drive out of a showroom through the glass.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — get into a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the window or glass frontage rather than a door. 'Classic style' is the series' oldest joke: the car leaves through the glass. Any vehicle showroom with a car you can enter should work.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom
Get into one of the display cars
Drive out through the glass
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.note: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, and follow through. The wording suggests simply playing at that named alley — likely a visit or a game rather than a score target, since the description sets no score. Go to the alley, start a game, and bowl it through.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Start a game of bowling
Play it through
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Timing note: the description is deliberately cryptic, but it points at a specific partnership moment rather than a repeatable activity. Moments like this in a story campaign usually cannot be replayed once their beat has passed, so take partner opportunities when the story offers them instead of walking past.
trophies.note: A one-off partnership moment; exact trigger unstated.
trophies.guide: The official description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — does not say plainly what to do, and this guide will not pretend otherwise. It most plausibly refers to a specific moment involving your partner that the story or a partner activity stages for you. The partner system is demonstrably real elsewhere on this sheet (Hot Together and Retail Therapy both require your partner), so a staged partner moment is a reasonable reading: when a partner-focused event presents itself, participate in it fully rather than skipping it, and the trophy should resolve itself at that moment.
steps: Keep your partner involved whenever an event features them
Take partner opportunities the story offers
Complete the partnership moment when it arrives
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Timing note: choices are made inside story beats, and a choice passed over in a one-time beat cannot be made later on the same save. The counter runs to 500, so take optional choices whenever they are offered rather than skipping past them, in case story choices are part of the count.
trophies.note: A 500-choice counter; story choices happen once.
trophies.guide: Make choices — the official summary notes the count runs to 500. Choices appear throughout the story and side content, so the habit to build is simple: engage with choice prompts instead of skipping them, and let the counter climb. The description does not say choices must be unique, so ordinary play should carry most of the total, with the counter here tracking the rest.
steps: Take choice prompts whenever the game offers them
Do not skip optional choices in story beats
Reach 500 choices made
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Timing note: succeeding on a second try means something must be failed first. If that something is a one-time story attempt, passing it cleanly the first time could close the window — where a story task can fail safely, do not reload a failure straight away.
trophies.note: Fail once, then succeed at the same thing.
trophies.guide: The description — 'Second time's the charm' — and the official summary both frame this as succeeding on a second try: fail at something, then succeed at the same thing on the retry. The description does not name the activity, so the honest approach is behavioural: when a retryable task fails, retry it and succeed instead of reloading a save, and note here where it happened if it pops.
steps: Attempt a task and let a genuine failure stand
Retry the same task immediately
Succeed on the second try
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.note: Witness something strange; no location is given.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description ('What the hell just happened?') is a reaction, not an instruction, and it names no place or event. This is most likely a scripted weird encounter somewhere in Leonida, of the kind the series hides in remote spots at odd hours. The exploration sweep for The Goodtime State doubles as the hunting ground for this: travel the far corners, especially at night, and when something inexplicable happens, stay and watch it play out instead of driving on.
steps: Explore remote areas, ideally at night
Investigate anything that looks staged or out of place
Witness the strange event through to its end
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PSNProfiles trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.note: Knock someone down with a melee swing from a moving vehicle.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, use the melee attack as you pass a pedestrian or enemy so the swing connects and bowls them over. Line up a slow pass rather than a fast one — you need the hit to land, not a collision. One clean knockdown should be enough, per the description's singular framing.
steps: Get in a vehicle and find a pedestrian or enemy on foot
Approach at a controlled speed
Melee attack as you pass so they are knocked down
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PlayStationTrophies.org trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.note: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, so the loop is: rob, pass the marked cash to your laundering contacts, repeat, and track the laundered total here rather than your bank balance. Only money actually laundered counts toward the quarter million, per the description's wording.
steps: Acquire marked bills from robberies
Deliver them to your laundering contacts
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: TrueTrophies trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.note: Spend $100,000 across shops in total.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. This is a pure spending total, so it completes itself if you buy vehicles, property upgrades, weapons and clothing as you play instead of hoarding cash. Track the running total here; purchases you would make anyway — garages for Little Boxes, for instance — all feed it.
steps: Buy what you need as you play rather than saving everything
Make big purchases like garages and vehicles through shops
Reach $100,000 spent in total
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: GTA Wiki (Fandom) trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.note: Buy all 8 garage properties.
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them, per the official summary. This is a money trophy in disguise: earn enough to buy every garage on the property market and buy them as they become affordable. The spending also feeds Treat Yo Self, so the two trophies progress together.
steps: Earn money through missions and robberies
Buy each garage property as it becomes affordable
Own all 8 garages
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: Push Square trophy guide (named source)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.note: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a vehicle you intend to keep, register it in the app straight away rather than back-filling later. Ten registrations is a small counter, so deliberate registration of your first ten kept vehicles finishes it early.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app when you acquire a vehicle
Register the vehicle
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered
trophies.source: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide advice: PowerPyx trophy guide (named source)
